title: VANOS minimum RPM
user_description: Adds a configurable minimum-RPM threshold for closed-throttle VANOS engagement on MS41.0. The default value preserves stock behavior; this patch has been tested on a vehicle.
description: Retrofits the MS41.3 cal-0x2DC VANOS min-RPM gate into MS41.0 (1429861). Splices the VANOS state-machine fd14.4 branch @0x02B7FA (stock 'jb fd14.4,0x02b802' -> unconditional VANOS-off) into a cave @0x30000 (CPU 0x34000, seg-3 FF block; seg-2 is fully packed). The cave re-tests fd14.4/fd14.5, reads the rpm/32 mirror 0xe9e2 (populated at 02b7c4 from 0xfae6, same var the engage routine reads at 02b812), and engages VANOS (0x02b80a) when rpm/32 >= new cal VANOSRPM else falls to stock off (0x02b802) -- i.e. when fd14.4 OR fd14.5 is set, VANOS now engages above the threshold instead of staying off. VANOSRPM@SA0x3000 (file 0x17000) ships at stock 0xFF (=8160 rpm, unreachable) so the image behaves IDENTICALLY to stock MS41.0 until armed via the RomRaider def (set it to e.g. 0x7D=4000rpm). Also writes an 8-byte version marker 'VANOSRT1' @file 0x17008 (cal blank tail, SA 0x3008) that RomRaider matches (via a dedicated variant rom placed before the generic ID41) so the retrofit table shows ONLY on this patched image, not on a stock MS41.0 partial. Splice+cave = program; the only cal change is the 8 marker bytes in blank tail (threshold stays 0xFF); MS41.0 has no runtime-enforced checksum -> recompute=[] (same pattern as ignition_cut). fd14.2 (flash-mode) still forces off, untouched. RISK: enables VANOS engagement at high-rpm closed-throttle/overrun that stock MS41.0 suppressed; this behavior has been tested and proven on-car.
